Generated Narrative: CodeSystem speiro-evidence-check-outcome

This case-sensitive code system https://fhir.speirotech.net/CodeSystem/speiro-evidence-check-outcome defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
passed PassedThe selected source check reports passed within its stated scope; no wider completeness claim.
failed FailedThe selected source check reports failed; no automatic treatment, payment or capture consequence.
unavailable UnavailableThe selected source check reports its outcome unavailable; no pass, failure or permission inference.
not-required Not requiredThe selected source check explicitly reports not required under its applicable context; not inferred from missing data.

name: SpeiroEvidenceCheckOutcome
title: Speiro Evidence Check Outcome
description: lossless canonical check outcomes; unavailable is not failed and not-required is not passed.
